- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pfizer is conducting a Phase 3 clinical trial for fidanacogene elaparvovec to evaluate its effectiveness and safety.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In November 2020, Pfizer announced positive results from a Phase 1b clinical trial of their investigational gene therapy for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD), called PF-06939926.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The results of the DMD trial showed that the gene therapy was generally well-tolerated and led to increased expression of the dystrophin protein.
